thread:
maria: Heads-up — PR #4827 is up for docs review. Small migration guide + a couple of SDK snippets. Can someone grab review + tone pass?
kevin: I can do a pass in ~30m. Is the CI/docs preview green?
maria: docs-bot says preview generated but CI failed on one link check. See below.
docs-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.com/4827 — Link-check failed: ./guides/migration.md: line 142: broken link to /api/old-client
jen: I can fix the broken link quickly. Also noticed a couple of instances using "we" instead of the guideline's preferred active second-person voice ("you"). Should we enforce that in this PR?
sam: +1 to enforcing voice. We should flag but avoid bikeshedding phrasing. Suggest a quick diff that switches obvious cases.
kevin: Agreed. I'll do a content pass and leave nit comments rather than block. If there are structural issues I'll call for rework.
ryan: FYI CI also reported a markdownlint warning for fenced code language on the python snippet. Says use ```python rather than ```py.
maria: Good catch. The snippet is in the SDK migration section. Want me to update both the language and the `we`->`you` changes and push a follow-up commit?
jen: If you can, please. Also add a short inline example showing error handling for the new client. Current example only shows success path.
maria: Will add a 3-line example: `try/except` + small note about raising RedwoodError.
kevin: One more style note: our terminology guide prefers "Dedicated" and "Private" capitalized when referencing product tiers. There are a few lowercase occurrences in the migration text. I left a couple of comments.
maria: I'll sweep for those too. Plan: fix link, adjust code fence, small example, tone swaps, and terminology caps. Then re-run preview. ETA ~25m.
kevin: Sounds good. I can run a focused review once preview passes. If green, we can merge in the current merge window (slot opens in ~2h).
jen: Also, could someone add an eval example asserting output stability after migration? Even one assert example helps QA.
sam: I can add a minimal pytest snippet. Will push as a separate commit to keep changes small.
docs-bot: Link-check passed on redeploy. Preview: https://preview.redwood.com/4827/changes
kevin: Looks much cleaner now. Two remaining nits: 1) short sentence fragments in the intro — convert to full sentence per style guide; 2) the code comment uses `//` in python sample, change to `#`.
maria: Fixed both and force-pushed.
kevin: Approving now. :shipit:
jen: Approved as well.
ryan: CI all green.
sam: LGTM.
maria: Thanks team — merging after the merge window opens. Will follow up with a release note line.
kevin: Thanks, Maria. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
jen: Nice coordinated sweep :tada:
